name: Kelly
source: She is one of [url=/c164391]Max[/url]'s classmates and a member of the school's track team. She loves to run and is always looking for new members. After she saw [url=/c164391]Max[/url] running at full speed to catch a thief, she became determined to recruit him. However, she always fails to invite him because [url=/c164391]Max[/url] simply does not like sports. Despite his refusal, she refuses to give up.
